commands.summary: Run the campaign summary reports ETL stream
examples: pm emailoctopus campaign summary reports list --json
pm emailoctopus campaigns list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create list reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus create list apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new contact list; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create list contact reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus create list contact apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: adds a new contact to a list, immediately eligible to receive future campaigns targeting it (unless status is PENDING on a double opt-in list)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create list field reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus create list field apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new custom field on a list; the field's type (NUMBER/TEXT/DATE) cannot be changed after creation
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create list tag reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus create list tag apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new tag on a list, up to that list's tag-count limit; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete list reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus delete list apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a list and all of its contacts/tags/custom fields
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete list contact reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus delete list contact apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a contact from a list and its subscription/consent history
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete list field reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus delete list field apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a custom field and its stored values from every contact on the list
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete list tag reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus delete list tag apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a tag from a list and from every contact currently carrying it
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Run the list contacts ETL stream
examples: pm emailoctopus list contacts list --json

commands.summary: Run the list tags ETL stream
examples: pm emailoctopus list tags list --json
pm emailoctopus lists list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the start automation reverse-ETL action

flags.name: list_member_id
flags.summary: Required list member id record field.

examples: pm emailoctopus start automation apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: enrolls a contact into a live automation sequence, triggering its configured emails/delays; the automation must already have the 'Started via API' trigger enabled in the EmailOctopus dashboard
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update list reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus update list apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: renames an existing list; the id used by campaigns/API integrations to reference it is unchanged
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update list contact reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus update list contact apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing contact's email/fields/tags/status; a status change to UNSUBSCRIBED or SUBSCRIBED changes future campaign eligibility for this recipient
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update list field reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus update list field apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: renames a custom field's label/tag or changes its fallback default; any email template referencing the old field tag stops resolving a value
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update list tag reverse-ETL action
examples: pm emailoctopus update list tag apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: renames an existing tag on a list; any external automation/segment referencing the old tag name stops matching contacts by that name
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
